ThingDef.label: joust flag A
ThingDef.description: Marks start point A for a joust. Put it at one end of the list. Flag B goes at the other end, on the same map. The flag takes the colour of the material you use (cloth or metal), so pick a strong colour like red to tell it apart from flag B.

ThingDef.label: joust flag B
ThingDef.description: Marks start point B for a joust. Put it at one end of the list. Flag A goes at the other end, on the same map. The flag takes the colour of the material you use (cloth or metal), so pick a strong colour like blue to tell it apart from flag A.

ThingDef.label: melee trophy post
ThingDef.description: The trophy post marking the center of the grand melee ground: an iron-rimmed shield and two crossed axes, so nobody wonders what happens here. Select the post to see the arena boundary: the auto button fits it to your enclosure (railings, walls, doors), the + and - buttons set a circle by hand. Fighters who leave the boundary are herded back to the center. The shield takes the colour of the material you build it from, so pick your house colours.
